## Dixlase Blade / UI / Frontend Rules

### View Logic Separation
- Do not directly reference `\App\Enums\*`, `\App\Helpers\*`, `\App\Services\*`, `\App\Models\*` classes in Blade templates
- Prepare all enum values/labels/option arrays, helper results, and service results in controllers and pass them as view variables
- Blade components receive necessary data as props (injected from parent views/controllers)
- Exception: Helper calls in shared full-screen partials (e.g. sidebar) are allowed
- **`@php` blocks are forbidden in admin Blade views** (except shared full-screen partials like sidebar)
  - Business logic, data transformations, and config array building must be done in controllers or Presenters
  - Allowed exceptions: inline expressions (`{{ $var ?? 'default' }}`), `old()` helper, simple variable assignments

### Semantic HTML
- Use appropriate HTML elements (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<article>`, `<aside>`, `<footer>`)
- Use headings `<h1>`–`<h6>` in logical order (no skipping), lists with `<ul>`/`<ol>`/`<dl>`, `<table>` for data only
- `<button>` for actions, `<a>` for navigation — do not use `<div onclick>`

### Tailwind CSS Spacing
- Use minimum spacing required — avoid large values like `pt-12` or `mt-16` without clear design reason
- Verify parent elements don't already provide spacing before adding padding/margin
- When modifying existing spacing, check impact across all pages using that layout

### Translation Key Scoping
- `lang/*/admin/navigation.php` is sidebar-only — do not reference from non-sidebar views
- Each view defines translation keys in its own file (e.g. `lang/*/admin/settings/base/index.php`)
- Components: `lang/*/components/<component-name>.php`

### Text Internationalization
- Do not hardcode text in views or flash messages — define in translation files
- Always provide both Japanese (`ja`) and English (`en`) translations

### Language Selection Fields
- Read supported languages from `config('language.languages')` — do not hardcode

### Blade Component Usage
- Use reusable components from core's `resources/views/components/`:
  - **Form**: `<x-form-text>`, `<x-form-textarea>`, `<x-form-select>`, `<x-form-toggle>`, `<x-form-radio-group>`, `<x-form-color>`, `<x-form-range>`, `<x-form-button>`, etc.
  - **UI**: `<x-ui-modal>`, `<x-ui-notification>`, `<x-ui-flash-message>`, `<x-ui-status-badge>`, `<x-ui-pagination>`, `<x-ui-tooltip>`, etc.
  - **Admin**: `<x-admin.save-button>`, `<x-admin.delete-button>`, `<x-admin.danger-zone>`, etc.
- Check existing components before creating new ones

### Form Components
- **Checkboxes**: Use `<x-form-toggle>` for all boolean inputs
- **Radio buttons**: Use `<x-form-radio-card-group>` for rich UI (icons, descriptions, badges). Use `xModel` prop for Alpine.js binding
- **Buttons**: Use `<x-form-button>` with `variant`/`size`/`icon` props
- **Admin save**: Use `<x-admin.save-button>` inside `@section('save')`
- **Flash messages**: Already included in admin layout — no need to add individually

### Icons
- Use **Font Awesome** (`<i class="fas fa-eye"></i>`) — no inline SVGs

### JavaScript / Style Inline Policy
- Separate JS/CSS into external files. Inline JS with nonce is acceptable but externalization is preferred
- **Core**: `resources/src/{admin,auth,common,components,front}/`
- **Plugins/themes**: `resources/src/` with `@push('scripts')` for built files
- JS in `js/` subdir, SCSS in `scss/` subdir, kebab-case file names

### Alpine.js Component Registration
- **Always use `Alpine.data()`** — do not use `window.*` global function pattern
- Register in external JS files, import before `Alpine.start()` in entry points

### No Inline Event Handlers
- Do not use `onclick`, `onchange`, `onsubmit`, etc. — CSP blocks them
- Use `addEventListener()` in external JS or Alpine.js directives (`@click`, `x-on:click`)
